facts.statement: Players who bought a $10 Free Realms game card at participating Walgreens and redeemed it on February 29, 2012 received the Wally Pet Pal plus 250 Station Cash (SC250).
facts.quote: Go to your local participating Walgreens and purchase a $10 Free Realms Game Card. Redeem in Free Realms or at www.soe.com/gamecards on February 29, 2012

article_summaries.title: Don't Forget About Leap Day Fun!
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com promo post (listed under 'What is New?') for a one-day Leap Day 2012 offer: a $10 Walgreens Free Realms Game Card redeemed on February 29, 2012 gave the Wally Pet Pal plus 250 Station Cash. The post's posting date is given only as relative ('1 month, 2 weeks ago') so the exact date is unknown. The locale table confirms the offer and names Wally the Leap Frog as the reward.
